[2] But then again, I I could invade his top side here because my top lane should have lane purity and I should be stronger than the Jarvon. So, because of that, I'm comfortable just invading here.
[2] So, now what's probably going to happen is that Java now is like, "Wait, hold up. Where are my camps?" So, now he's two options. G my laners or look for an invade.
